verdict: Paid channels are dark; organic signals are softening across all three businesses.
narrative: Across Forte Metals, Advance Grinding, and O'Hare Precision, no paid spend ran in the last 28 days — zero leads were generated through Meta or Google Ads for any entity. All inbound activity came from Google Business Profile, which produced a combined 400 actions (directions, calls, and web clicks) across the three locations, but that organic signal is now declining: GBP engagement fell between 39% and 57% week-over-week at each location, and search clicks are softening in parallel. The root cause being addressed is a combination of paused paid campaigns and eroding organic visibility, with SEO remediation and a contact outreach sequence both targeted for completion by August 31. Next period, you should expect CRM milestones to close, outreach sequences to launch, and a clearer picture of paid campaign readiness.
